prompt: Write a detailed, well-structured beginner's guide to brewing coffee at home. Cover equipment, grind size, water temperature, ratios, and at least four brewing methods (drip, French press, pour-over, espresso). Use clear sections and aim for a thorough, complete guide.

Write a long, coherent short story (multiple scenes) about a lighthouse keeper who discovers a message in a bottle. Give it a beginning, middle, and end, with consistent characters and setting throughout.

Write a comprehensive explanation, in many sections, of how the internet delivers a web page from a server to a browser. Cover DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, routing, TLS, and rendering. Be thorough and keep it coherent from start to finish.
Write a thorough beginner's guide to starting a vegetable garden. Cover site selection, soil preparation, choosing crops by season, watering, pest management, and harvesting. Use clear sections.
Write a comprehensive guide to preparing for a technical interview as a software engineer. Cover data structures, algorithms, system design, behavioural questions, and a study schedule.
Write a comprehensive, multi-section explanation of how vaccines work, covering the immune system, antigens, memory cells, different vaccine types, and herd immunity.
Explain in depth how a modern CPU executes a program, covering fetch-decode-execute, pipelining, branch prediction, caches, and out-of-order execution. Use many sections.
Write a detailed explanation of climate change: the greenhouse effect, main emission sources, observed impacts, and mitigation strategies. Use clear headed sections.
Write a long, coherent short story with multiple scenes about a cartographer who discovers that one of her maps predicts events before they happen. Maintain consistent character names throughout.
Write a long, multi-scene story about the last night shift at a train station that is closing after a hundred years. Keep the characters and their names consistent.
Write a detailed technical document explaining how a relational database executes a SELECT query, from parsing through query planning, index selection, join algorithms, and result materialisation.
Write an in-depth explanation of how distributed consensus works, covering the problem, Paxos, Raft, leader election, log replication, and failure handling.
Write a long, well-argued essay on whether cities should be designed primarily around cars or around pedestrians. Present both sides fairly before concluding.
Write a detailed essay on the history and development of written language, from cuneiform through alphabets to digital text.
Write a complete, step-by-step tutorial on building and deploying a small web application, covering project setup, backend, frontend, database, testing, and deployment.
